verses.pali: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi anattā.
verses.english: The cause and reason that gives rise to the eye is also not-self.

verses.pali: Anattasambhūtaṁ, bhikkhave, cakkhu kuto attā bhavissati …pe…
verses.english: Since the eye is produced by what is not-self, how could it be self?

verses.pali: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya, sopi anattā.
Anattasambhūtā, bhikkhave, jivhā kuto attā bhavissati …pe…
Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi anattā.
verses.english: The cause and reason that gives rise to the mind is also not-self.

verses.pali: Anattasambhūto, bhikkhave, mano kuto attā bhavissati.
verses.english: Since the mind is produced by what is not-self, how could it be self?
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
